summary: Versioned task spec schema, stdlib validator, and gh plate tasks validate for .agentic/tasks/*.yml.
migration_impact: Adopters may add .agentic/tasks/*.yml crew specs and run gh plate tasks validate locally; no workflow or label changes.
migration_guidance: 1. Copy examples from src/plate_core/data/examples/ into .agentic/tasks/ when piloting agent crews.
2. Run gh plate tasks validate (or python -m plate_core.task_spec) before committing task specs.
3. Reference MCP tool profile names from tool_profiles.py in tools.profiles; level and route stay in the YAML, not GitHub labels.
agent_notes: Task specs extend the #395 delegation packet with typed IO, model tiers, tool allow-lists, and static next edges. Role may be inferred from issue type/labels at runtime; validate with tasks validate.
